newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil ex-soldier runs amok, kills 12 people.
newsitem.headline: Brazil ex-soldier runs amok, kills 12 people.

text.p: A former soldier armed with two guns and a grenade killed 12 people on Thursday in a small town in northeastern Brazil before dying in a shootout with police, a police spokesman said.

Genildo Ferreira shot dead his wife and mother-in-law and then ran into the streets, where he killed at least another 10 people before taking a mother and her small daughter hostage, the spokesman said.

"Ferreira heard his wife was having an affair and that people were saying he was homosexual. That's when he went crazy and just started shooting," the spokesman said. "He was armed with two handguns and a grenade."

Two people were injured in the shooting spree in Sao Goncalo do Amarante in the state of Rio Grande do Norte and the lover of Ferreira's wife was also believed to have been killed, but his body had not yet been found, he added.
Ferreira, who was hiding out in a ceramic tile factory with his hostages, was shot dead in a gun fight with police and the two hostages were freed unharmed, the spokesman said.
The 27-year-old former soldier left the military five years ago and was working at a local tile factory.
